rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: A penetration testing toolkit that integrates Kali Linux security tools through a Flask API server. Provides tool functions covering reconnaissance (nmap, theHarvester, subfinder), web application testing (sqlmap, gobuster, nikto, nuclei), Active Directory attacks (BloodHound, CrackMapExec), network pivoting (chisel, SSH tunneling), and session management for Metasploit and reverse shells. Designed for security professionals to conduct authorized penetration tests with persistent sessions and comprehensive logging.
